payload.title: Chasing cyclicities
payload.summary: This notebook demonstrates the use of spectral and wavelet analysis features of Pyleoclim to explore periodicities in a 5-million-year sea surface temperature record from Site ODP846 in the Eastern Equatorial Pacific. The analysis aims to identify coherency between insolation and the temperature record. The notebook utilizes various detrending methods and spectral analysis techniques to examine the data, including the Lomb-Scargle periodogram and wavelet analysis. The results are compared with the Benthic LR04 stack to investigate the impact of orbital signals on climate.
goals: Explore periodicities in a sea surface temperature record.
Identify coherency between insolation and temperature records.
Compare results with the Benthic LR04 stack.
Investigate the effect of age uncertainty on spectral analysis.
